daily.map.first.text: This is Monster Island! Follow today's glowing trail to find lost sparks!

daily.map.hello.text: Here's today's adventure! Tap the glowing stop to begin.

daily.map.next.text: Great going! Let's walk to the next stop.

daily.map.last.text: One more stop to finish today's adventure!

daily.map.pick.text: Last stop! You choose. Which adventure would you like?

daily.map.newday.text: Good morning! A brand-new trail is ready for today.

daily.explore.hello.text: Pick any adventure you like! Each one counts on today's trail.

daily.end.title.text: That's today's adventure! You kept trying, and you learned so much.

daily.end.yawn.text: Yaaawn! All that learning makes monsters sleepy.

daily.end.tomorrow.text: Come back tomorrow, when the sun comes up. Sleep tight!

daily.teaser.new.text: Tomorrow, a brand-new adventure is waiting for you!

daily.teaser.more.text: Tomorrow, your friends have more adventures for you!

daily.recap.counting-adventure.text: You counted Bobbo's snacks, one by one!

daily.recap.glow-cave-hops.text: You hopped along the number line to add!

daily.recap.sky-balloon-race.text: You added numbers to fly the balloon!

daily.recap.cookie-kitchen.text: You shared cookies fairly, so every plate was the same!
